sibling_sites_checked: The other contract.approve sites in the census: src/bot.ts:226 (locked lexical, dead maybeApproveForChain), src/exitEngine.ts:421 (locked transitive via ensureApproval), src/exitEngine.ts:544 (locked lexical); script approves scripts/addLiquidity.ts:48 and :53 and scripts/recover-sell-ladys.ts:70 run in their own processes (AUD-SCRIPTS-002). It is the only src tx-signing site of the 11 that is not locked, and the census found no unknown site.
severity_rationale: S1 by the 22-26 census rule: every src transaction-signing site that is not proven to run under the nonce lock is a D-NONCE-AUTHORITY-ALL violation candidate graded S1 or above. If it runs while the bot is trading, the approve can take the same nonce as a buy or sell of the same wallet; one of the two is then dropped or replaced, and a dropped sell leaves the position held (STRAND). Mitigating fact, recorded honestly: the site is unreachable at the base (no caller; imported but never called; tests mock it), which is why AUD-BUY-007 graded the same defect S2 as a re-introduction hazard. Merge: duplicate of AUD-BUY-007 (same site, same defect); the canonical must carry the higher severity, the union of evidence and this escalation at consolidation (22-28) unless the operator rules otherwise at ESC-CENSUS-01.
recommendation: Delete simulateSell and its import at src/bot.ts:17 (no caller, so no behaviour change), as AUD-BUY-007 recommends; if a sell simulation is ever needed again, use staticCall only and never sign. Phase 23 cannot assert "every src signing site is locked" while this site exists. Owner: Phase 24 if it touches tokenSafety.ts first, else Phase 29. Nothing is changed in Phase 22.
